metadata.summary: Jitin ordered an Omelet Wrap from Manhattan Bagel without any modifications.

messages.text: Hello Jitin, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
Actually, I I want to order, hot, sorry, omelette wrap.
The Omelet Wrap, great choice! That's one of our popular items with 3 eggs, cheese, and your choice of meat in a tortilla. Let me get the options for your omelet wrap...
Let me get the options for your omelet wrap... I'll check on the meat choices for you. We have bacon, sausage, and ham. Which one would you like?
Can you please make it simple? Do not add any modification. Just place the order.
Alright, let me add that to your order...
Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
Call ended before tool response was received
